services.name: Group Rentals
services.desc: Camping with a group or just need extra space? We’ve got you covered! Casini Ranch offers a variety of group sites throughout the park, perfect for gatherings like birthday parties, reunions, and special events. Our group sites offer ample space for larger gatherings, accommodating multiple RVs, tents, or a combination of both. Most sites include a potable water spigot, picnic tables, and a fire pit for a classic camping experience. We have four Large Group sites available (East Group, West Group, 48 Group, and McClarty Field Group) which accommodate up to 40 people and include 24 occupants in the base rate (please note, 24 maximum adults allowed).
